name: Affogato AI
long_description:
Affogato is an AI creative studio for brands, agencies, eCommerce sellers and creators. One account and one credit wallet give you 120+ of the best image, video and voice models, plus studios built for the jobs people actually need done. Swap the cast of any video, turn a script into a talking-head episode, design a custom voice, lip-sync a character to a voiceover, make studio headshots, and upscale to true 8K, all without editing skills. Type an idea and get campaign-ready TikToks, Reels, Shorts and ads in minutes.

Everything in the app is also available to developers and AI agents. A REST API and an MCP server let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and your own code run the same models and studios from the same wallet.
one_liner: AI studio for videos, ads and avatars, in your browser or your agent

launches.title: Affogato MCP: Make videos, talking heads and ads from inside Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
launches.tagline: Add one URL to your AI assistant and ask for the finished video, headshot or ad. No API key, no new app to learn.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Affogato is now an MCP server. Add `https://api.affogato.ai/mcp` to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code or Codex, sign in once, and your assistant can make images, video and voice with 120+ AI models and our studio workflows. Every spend is quoted first and stays inside limits you set.

<https://youtu.be/MeuNpDvM_uA>

### **The problem**

Your team already lives in Claude and ChatGPT. That's where the script gets written, the campaign gets planned and the product copy gets polished. Then someone has to leave, open three AI tools, re-upload the same photos, copy prompts across, pay for each tool separately and stitch the result back together.

Raw model APIs don't fix it. An agent can call a video model, but it doesn't know how to make a talking-head episode, a product ad or a headshot that doesn't look AI. That knowledge lives in the studio, not the model.

### **The solution**

Affogato MCP puts the whole Affogato studio inside your assistant:

* **Studio workflows as single tools:** talking heads, lipsync, voiceovers, headshots and virtual try-on. Ask for the outcome; the agent picks the steps.
* **120+ models behind one connection:** image, video and voice models, from the same catalog as our app.
* **Sign in, don't paste keys:** OAuth. You pick the workspace the agent may spend from and approve it once.
* **Spend rails built for agents:** `estimate_cost` quotes every request before it runs, anything above your threshold waits for your OK, a daily cap stops runaway loops, and failed or cancelled generations are refunded in full.
* **One wallet:** the agent spends the same credits as your team does in the app and the API.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=129608&key=user_uploads/218500/74f211dd-584d-4aa3-8c9a-9b548c9f70e3)

### **Try it**

Paste the URL into your assistant (Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector), sign in, then try:

* "Give me a professional headshot from this selfie, corporate style."
* "Voice this script with a warm female voice, then lipsync it to this video."
* "Put this hoodie on a model in a street scene, three angles."
* "Make a 15-second talking-head video of me reading this script."

Your files stay simple: when a request needs a photo, a clip or a voice track from your device, the assistant sends an upload link and carries on once the file is in.

Developers: `claude mcp add --transport http affogato https://api.affogato.ai/mcp`, plus a REST API with webhooks and Agent Skills at github.com/affogato-ai/skills. We're listed in the official MCP registry as `ai.affogato/affogato`.

### **Launch offer**

Use code **MCP10** at checkout for 10% off your first month on any Affogato plan. Valid until January 17, 2027.

### **Our ask**

* Try it in the assistant you already use and tell us what broke: [hello@affogato.ai](mailto:hello@affogato.ai).
* Building an agent that needs media? Talk to us about the API.
* Intros to marketing teams and agencies that already run on Claude or ChatGPT.

Setup guide: <https://affogato.ai/mcp>

— Bhagaban and Nakul

launches.title: Affogato Video Agent: Create Viral TikTok/IG videos with AI
launches.tagline: Just describe your idea — Affogato Video Agent handles everything: script, voice, visuals, scenes, and edits. Create polished, TikTok-ready ads in minutes without touching a timeline.
launches.body:
[**Affogato Video Agent**](https://affogato.ai) **lets you create TikTok ads and short-form videos from just a prompt — no editing, no crew, no prior experience needed.**

We built this because making videos is still too slow and expensive — especially when you need fresh content every week. With Affogato, you just describe what you want (like “a talking ad for my skincare brand” or “a funny video about missing your morning coffee”), and the agent takes care of everything: script, visuals, voice, music, and timing.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rGv7R8YFCOk

It works great for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts — and we’re seeing early traction with e-commerce brands, content marketers, and solo creators using it to launch products, run ads, and grow their audience.

Here’s what you can expect:

* Type an idea → get a full video in minutes
* Includes script, voiceover, visuals, music, and editing — auto-generated
* Works for product showcases, character videos, UGC-style ads, and more
* No timeline editing or video tools needed

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92745&key=user_uploads/218500/50540ef3-5226-4b0b-bbad-f9ac430b7a51)

( Prompt - Create a Pokemon themed ad for IKEA. The video agent does everything from creating scenes to adding music and voiceover. )

1.5 million creators and businesses are already using Affogato to create marketing content at scale.

If you’re spending hours (or dollars) making videos, give Affogato a shot — it might save you both.

Try Affogato at https://affogato.ai .

launches.title: RenderNet AI: Create consistent AI characters
launches.tagline: RenderNet brings consistency and control over AI image generations.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're [BB](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhagaban/), [Nakul](https://twitter.com/MaruPelkar) & [Sriharsha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sriharshasetty/). We’re building [RenderNet AI](https://rendernet.ai) - an AI image generation tool for visual storytelling.

**Try RenderNet** - <https://rendernet.ai>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79116&key=user_uploads/218500/72d168cf-c52b-4ae9-8b2a-076a0c9ce251)

### The problem

AI image generation is a powerful storytelling tool for social media, marketing, education, and entertainment. Yet, a recurring challenge lies in _preserving continuity across a series of images._

Let's say you _generate 5 images featuring the same fictional character_ - each one could render them with a completely different face, ethnicity, clothing, and overall appearance.

This _lack of consistency_ makes it extremely difficult to use those AI-generated images together cohesively for narratives, marketing campaigns, or any project requiring a unified character identity throughout.

### The solution

[RenderNet](https://rendernet.ai) is a new AI image generation tool with a focus on consistency and control via its features - _Facelock_ and _ControlNet_.

**Facelock** enables a consistent face across all your creations. Whether you start with an AI-generated image or upload a photo, FaceLock maintains that face's integrity in every new image prompted. This ensures unparalleled continuity in your visual narratives.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79116&key=user_uploads/218500/fe70e107-5813-4708-bcd7-0c63766b0ef1)

**ControlNet** lets you upload a reference image to guide the pose, composition, and style within your AI-generated visuals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79116&key=user_uploads/218500/68211b19-352c-4315-9a7b-ba5b286e1967)

Combining Facelock and ControlNet transforms your AI image generation process, offering unparalleled consistency and control. This dynamic duo ensures your characters remain true to your vision, from their facial features to their poses and styles.

Whether you're crafting a comic series, designing an ebook, or creating a [virtual influencer](https://twitter.com/CharaspowerAI/status/1754183001066410266) akin to [Aitana Lopez](https://www.euronews.com/next/2024/01/20/meet-the-first-spanish-ai-model-earning-up-to-10000-per-month), Rendernet becomes an indispensable tool in your creative arsenal.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79116&key=user_uploads/218500/b5c5f33c-2306-4004-a95c-fe66a61f4462)

**Our ask**
